intro: Coverage of critical-infrastructure threats across 30 articles from 12 April to 23 September 2026 spans APT33, CL-STA-1062, and CyberAv3ngers, alongside CVE-2026-24032, rated CVSS 7.3. Reporting centres on energy, critical infrastructure, government, critical-infrastructure, and utilities, with incidents reaching the United states, Global, North america, Europe, and Asia-pacific. The severity mix comprises 15 high, 3 critical, 3 informational, and 1 medium finding.
